scope: F2 fold-0 screen. New model: Generalized Additive Model with splines (pyGAM or sklearn SplineTransformer + LinearRegression). Captures non-linear univariate effects and bivariate interactions.

H62_GAM_SPLINES.question: Does a GAM with spline basis (univariate + bivariate interactions) improve fold-0 OOF AUC on the rich view?
H62_GAM_SPLINES.method: Use sklearn SplineTransformer (degree=3, n_knots=10) on the 285-feature rich view, then LogisticRegression. Cross-fit 5-fold: fit on folds 1-4, predict fold-0. Measure fold-0 port_delta vs champion.
H62_GAM_SPLINES.leakage: SplineTransformer fit on FIT only (folds 1-4), transform fold-0. LogisticRegression fit on FIT. Fold-safe.
H62_GAM_SPLINES.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
